annotations.title: Create a free seven-day webhook inbox

description: Create a hosted webhook inbox without signing up. The inbound URL keeps receiving when this chat or MCP process closes. Returns inbound_url, a private api_key to reconnect, and the owner's private claim_url to keep the URL beyond 7 days. This process connects immediately. Read deliveries with anyhook_events and anyhook_inspect.

destination_url.description: Optional forwarding destination for the new endpoint.

source.description: Optional provider name (stripe, github, shopify, ...). Leave it out to accept any sender: naming one makes the edge refuse (401) requests without that provider's signature header, curl tests included.

name: anyhook_quickstart
title: Create a free seven-day webhook inbox
